description: This file defines the API endpoint class for managing Claim Events in the OrangeHRM system, implementing CRUD operations such as create, retrieve, update, and delete for claim event data, along with validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: ClaimEventAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing Claim Events, providing CRUD operations and validation logic, integrated with OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new Claim Event, initializing a ClaimEvent object with provided parameters and saving it.

methods.name: setClaimEvent
methods.description: Sets the properties of a ClaimEvent object based on request parameters and persists it via the DAO.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Claim Events based on search filters, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing Claim Events, including optional filters and sorting parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a Claim Event, including required name and optional description and status.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Creates a validation rule for the 'name' property of ClaimEvent, enforcing uniqueness and length constraints.

methods.name: getClaimEventCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Returns a configuration object for specifying uniqueness validation behavior, ignoring deleted entities.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes Claim Events by provided IDs after verifying their existence.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for the delete operation, ensuring IDs are provided and are valid integers.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Claim Event by ID, including whether it can be edited based on its usage.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rule for the getOne method, enforcing positive integer ID parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Claim Event, with logic to prevent name modification if the event is already used.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a Claim Event, including optional description, status, and name uniqueness.
